title: Authority Handover Failure Modes
summary: Work through Authority Handover Failure Modes.

blocks.md: This lesson follows **Authority Handover Failure Modes** in *Supervisory Intervention* (Vol IV).

blocks.source: Vol IV, Supervisory Intervention, § Authority Handover Failure Modes
blocks.md: When the warehouse mobile manipulator's perception policy meets an unmodeled specular reflection from wet shrink-wrap on a pallet, depth artifacts drop its confidence and the runtime asks a remote assistant to reposition the gripper. If the console grants manual joystick authority over the arm without locking the base channel or announcing that the base is still moving, an assistant focused on aligning the fingers assumes the chassis is stationary. Meanwhile the autonomous navigation thread keeps driving the wheels into a rack upright.

blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Authority record matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: The authority record binds a sealed static authority manifest to a per-tick evidence tuple of time, authority state, measured state, proposed and admitted commands, so every handover is reconstructable and attributable.

questions.q: The section **Authority Handover Failure Modes** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Protective stops never wait for verification while motion commands, which inject energy, must be authenticated, attributable, and fresh, and the verifier's availability must itself be protected.

The authority record binds a sealed static authority manifest to a per-tick evidence tuple of time, authority state, measured state, proposed and admitted commands, so every handover is reconstructable and attributable.

Autonomous chunks and manual sessions hold separate leases on the safety MCU's clock, so a silent policy, a dropped link, or an incapacitated operator loses authority to a state-matched local fallback.
Blending human and policy commands works only when goals are unimodal and every intermediate blend is admissible; across modes a convex combination is a new, unchecked command.
